programs.name: Computer Science BSc
programs.a_level_offer: A*AA, to include A-level Mathematics grade A
programs.ib_offer: 7,6,6 at Higher Level to include 6 in Mathematics, with a minimum of 32 points overall; also 5 in Standard Level English
programs.ap_offer: No course-specific AP grades are published. US route (general): a minimum 3.2/4.0 unweighted GPA on the High School Diploma plus three distinct subject tests from IB HL, AP tests, Honours classes (Yr 11/12) and college-level/dual-level classes; ACT 28+ or SAT-R 1350+ may replace one subject test (not a subject requirement; no SAT superscores). The page's equivalents table maps AP 5 to both A* and A, AP 4 to B, AP 3 to C. Where A-level Maths is required, applicants must present AP Calculus BC or IB HL Mathematics (AP Calculus AB not accepted). APs must be the certified test, not just the class. By the table, A*AA corresponds to APs at 5,5,5 including Calculus BC (derived, not printed for this course).
programs.required_subjects: A-level Mathematics grade A (IB: 6 at HL Mathematics); 3 A-levels; General Studies and Critical Thinking not accepted; some programming experience desirable but not essential
programs.toefl_note: Birmingham English Group A. TOEFL iBT taken before Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 80 overall with no less than 19 in Reading, 19 in Listening, 21 in Speaking and 19 in Writing. Tests taken from Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4.5 overall with no less than 4 in each skill.
programs.english_note: Birmingham English Group A: IELTS 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in any band; PTE 64 with no less than 59 in all four skills.
programs.notes: Typical offer for September 2027 entry. Contextual offer: AAA to include A in Maths or Further Maths. Fee is the 2027/28 international tuition fee per year shown in the page's international fees box (the page shows UK/Ireland GBP 10,050 by default). AP route: https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/study/international/country/usa . English requirements by course group: https://www.birmingham.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/apply/entry-requirements/international-entry-requirements
